deviceSessions.title: Sign-in sessions
deviceSessions.browserNote: A session identifies a browser sign-in, not a physical device or the person using a shared staff account.
deviceSessions.limitConflict: The limit cannot be lowered below the number of active sessions, or the data has changed. Revoke a session and retry.
deviceSessions.loginLimit: This account has reached its sign-in session limit. Ask your administrator to revoke an old session; existing sessions will not be automatically signed out.
deviceSessions.confirmCurrent: Revoke your current session and sign out immediately?
deviceSessions.confirmAll: Revoke every session for this account?

managerUi.subtitle: Manage your branch's operations account, recovery email and access history.
managerUi.noBranch: This account is not assigned to a branch. Please contact an administrator.
managerUi.protected: Changes require your current password and OTP verification.

directory.scope: Each branch has one manager account and one shared operations account.
directory.selectHint: Review status, lock or unlock accounts, assist with recovery and inspect access history.
directory.subtitle: Manage accounts, security and access history for each branch.
directory.search: Search branch name, ID or address

title: Branch accounts
accessSubtitle: Enter the email code to set a password.
fromEmailHelp: Enter the challenge ID (UUID) and 8-digit OTP from the same email, then set a password. Each account has its own code.
requestAgain: Step 1 · Get a code by email
requestAgainHelp: Already have a code? Go straight to step 2. Otherwise select the account and request a new one.
activationHelp: Only for an account that has never set a password. Manager and Staff need separate codes, even with one recovery mailbox.
resetHelp: For an account already activated that needs a password reset. Codes go to the branch recovery email.
requestQueued: Request received. If the account is eligible, a new code will be emailed. Once issued, a new code invalidates the previous one.
resendRequested: A new code was requested for {{login}}. Check the recovery inbox; previous codes will no longer work.
resendWarning: Resending invalidates the old activation code. Match the login and role in the email before using a code.
emailLogShared: The log below is filtered by mailbox and may include other branches sharing that address. Check the login and challenge ID in the email before using it.
alreadySignedIn: You are signed in as {{login}}. You may activate a different account or return to management.
loginAfterPassword: Password updated. Please sign in with your new password.
loginAfterRecovery: The shared recovery email has been updated. Please sign in again.
singleRecoveryEmailHelp: One recovery email is shared by the Manager and Staff accounts at this branch.
sharedEmailChangeInfo: The new email becomes the recovery mailbox for both Manager and Staff. OTP verification is required and related sessions will be revoked.
accountResetInfo: Help reset the password for {{login}}. Only the selected account password will change.
selfPasswordHelp: Verify your identity before setting a new password. All existing sessions will be revoked on completion.
selfPasswordSent: A code was sent to your branch's shared recovery mailbox. Enter the latest OTP to continue.
selfPasswordReturn: Back to request a new code
selfPasswordMissingEmail: Missing the code? Return to the previous step to request a new one.
resendAfterOtp: Missing the code? Close this dialog and resend from the unactivated account card, or use Activate / recover.
requestAnotherManagementCode: Go back to request a new code
managementResendHelp: Enter your current password again in step 1 to request a new OTP. The previous code will stop working.
pending: Store saved, not ready to open. Track the account pair under Accounts.
lockConfirm: Change status and revoke all sessions of this account?
auditNotice: A shared account and session do not identify an employee. Managers only see Staff actions at their own branch.
unprovisioned: This branch has no Manager or Staff accounts yet.
recoveryMissing: Not configured; contact an Admin to set up the recovery email.
adminHelp: Admin assistance: primary OTP goes to the stored Admin email. Recovery changes also require the new email OTP.
managerHelp: Recovery changes require your current password and OTPs at both old and new emails.
manageSent: Challenge created. Check the correct recipient inbox; this challenge is bound to the current session.
branchActivationGuide: Each account has its own code. Activate both Manager and Staff before opening.
branchDeliveryGuide: SENT: accepted by SMTP. FAILED/EXPIRED: delivery failed or code expired.
branchDeliveryScope: Recent emails sent to the recovery mailbox.
branchDeliveryEmpty: No activation email has been recorded for this mailbox yet.
branchResendGuide: Expired code or missing email? Select Resend activation email on the correct unactivated account card.
